title: Which operation comes first?
text: Order of operations: multiplication and division are done before addition and subtraction, unless parentheses say otherwise. A common mistake is to add $$6 + 4$$ first just because those numbers are written on the left. In $$6 + 4 \times 5$$, which operation do you do first?

title: Compute the product
text: The factor pair that must be combined first is $$4 \times 5$$. That product is what you will add to 6. What is $$4 \times 5$$?

title: Add the remaining term
text: The expression is now $$6$$ plus that product. Addition is the lower-priority operation, so it happens second. What is $$6 + 20$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$6 + 4 \times 5 = 6 + 20 = 26$$. Common mistake: adding $$6 + 4$$ first to get $$10 \times 5 = 50$$. General rule: when multiplication and addition are both present, multiply first, then add.
